evidence: Labeled Wallet; modifies src/wallet/rpc/encrypt.cpp to deprecate encryptwallet behind -deprecatedrpc=encryptwallet.
rationale: Deprecates a dangerous wallet footgun that can cause loss of funds when restoring from pre-encryption backups. As noted in the description, encrypting an existing wallet 'creates a new seed that can invalidate pre-encryption backups' and silently alters spending conditions on imported descriptors.
